newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-NIGERIANS UCHE AND OKOCHA TO BECOME TURKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIANS UCHE AND OKOCHA TO BECOME TURKS.

text.p: Nigerian footballers Uche Okechukwa and Augustine "Jay Jay" Okocha who play for Istanbul club Fenerbahce, are planning to become Turkish citizens and change their names.
The players' new names will be Abdulkerim Rahim Uche and Muhammed Yavuz Okacha, club spokesman Turgut Acar said on Friday.

Fenerbahce, due to play their return match with Manchester United in the European Champions' League on Wednesday night, have persuaded the pair to become Turks to enable the club to purchase two new foreign players next season, Acar said.
In a similar move, Croatian goalkeeper Marijan Mrmic has said he would be proud to become a Turkish citizen if it would help his Istanbul club Besiktas, Turkish media reported on Friday.
